description: NaTbGeO₄ is Hausmannite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent TbO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TbO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-66°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.56 Å. Tb is bonded to six O atoms to form TbO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent TbO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-66°. There are a spread of Tb-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.38 Å. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent TbO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one TbO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-63°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.81 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Tb, and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Tb, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Tb, and one Ge atom.
